notes.message: 83 more trials mention the drug or condition only in descriptions, often as one of several permitted options. They are listed under mentions but not counted. Set retrieval.name_matching to mentioned to count them.

Lung cancer also includes trials whose MeSH condition is "Adenocarcinoma of Lung", "Bronchial Neoplasms", "Carcinoma, Bronchogenic", "Carcinoma, Non-Small-Cell Lung" or "Mesothelioma, Malignant", which sit under it in the MeSH tree.
